name: VOVV
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: VOVV connects your AI assistant to the VOVV.AI creative studio for e-commerce brands. Browse your products, brand profiles, and image and video library. Import products from store or image links. Find scenes and models, get shoot recommendations, and create product photos and videos. Explore competitor ads, newsletters, social posts, and blog articles available through VOVV.AI. Image and video creation requires approval of the credit cost and uses your signed-in account, plan, and credit balance. Connect with your VOVV.AI account using OAuth.
summary_ja: 商品画像・動画を制作し、競合の広告やコンテンツを調べる。
limitations_ja: VOVV.AIアカウントをOAuth接続。画像・動画の制作にはクレジット費用の承認が必要と説明。
